title: Thousand Islands Ship Times at Boldt Castle | Chris Izworski
description: When will the next freighter pass Boldt Castle or Clayton? Live St. Lawrence ship reports turned into tested passage windows, plus where to watch.

alexandria-bay.name: Scenic View Park
alexandria-bay.description: A small village park on the river with a view across to Heart Island and Boldt Castle. Ships pass through the American Narrows off the village.
alexandria-bay.sourceNote: Alexandria Bay Chamber directory lists Scenic View Park under Must See & Do | Public Facilities; OpenStreetMap way 469073736 (leisure=park). Checked 2026-11-27.

clayton.name: Frink Park and the Riverwalk
clayton.description: The village's riverfront park on the former rail and ferry terminal, joined to the Clayton Riverwalk. Ships pass between the village and Grindstone Island.
clayton.sourceNote: Village of Clayton LWRP Map 6 (March 2026) shows Frink Park in the village center on the river; NY DOS describes the Riverwalk and Frink Park pavilion. Coordinates approximate. Checked 2026-11-27.
